name: workspace
description: Your work device: list folders/files and create folders INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. The context shows only the top level (folders as folder/ with item counts); call list with a folder path to enter it before reading anything inside. Every file, upload, or project lives inside Workspace — one new folder per project or task. Paths outside Workspace are BLOCKED.

action.description: list: show one folder level. create_folder: make a new folder. delete_file: delete one file (also deletes its document embeddings).

path.description: Workspace-relative folder to list or create inside. Empty means the Workspace root.

name.description: Folder name for create_folder, or file name for delete_file.
